notes.title: Sin Slayers: Meat & Greed is coming soon!
notes.content: [p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p]We’re excited to announce [b]Sin Slayers: Meat & Greed[/b] — a brand-new idle game you don’t even have to [i]actively[/i] play.[/p][p][b]Sin Slayers: Meat & Greed[/b] is a cozy idle-mining simulator that quietly runs on your screen. Guide a lone dwarf miner as he digs through the cursed lands beneath the world of [b]Sin Slayers[/b] — collecting gems and uncovering the darkness below.[/p][p]📦 Mine gems 📈 Buy upgrades 💤 Complete missions (or let them complete themselves)[/p][p]Play while doing something else. Or nothing at all. That’s the beauty of idling.[/p][p][/p][p]🖱️ [b]Wishlist now and let the greed begin.[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720590/Sin_Slayers_Meat__Greed/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3]Trailer[/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="pYRS2prue20;full"][/previewyoutube]
